subject: math
description: Calculate semicircle areas from a radius or diameter and explain why the answer is half of a circle's area.
learningObjectives: Identify a semicircle as exactly one half of a circle
Use the formula A = (1/2)pi r^2 to find the area of a semicircle
Find the radius when a semicircle problem gives the diameter
Calculate semicircle areas using pi = 3.14 when directed
Solve real-world semicircle area problems and explain common errors
prerequisites: Know that the diameter of a circle is twice the radius
Calculate the area of a circle using A = pi r^2
Round decimal answers to a requested place value
